Different contexts One shared aspiration: a cleaner, more reliable energy future.

This International Youth Day, the UN’s theme is “Different Contexts, Common Aspirations.” 

It maps almost exactly onto what young people are telling us. Through the NextGen Energy Champions Initiative young people across the globe have been sharing what the clean energy transition means to them.

Their circumstances differ, but the shared direction is clear: reliable power, cleaner air, and a future where opportunity isn’t constrained by gaps in energy access. 

We’ll continue amplifying these voices through the NextGen Energy Champions Initiative. Different contexts, one future.
